meanings.en: to make or become stronger or more difficult to break or defeat
meanings.exampleEn: The new laws will toughen penalties for drunk driving.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasalar alkollü araç kullanmanın cezalarını sertleştirecek.

meanings.en: to make a material harder or more resistant
meanings.exampleEn: The glass is treated to toughen it against impact.
meanings.exampleTr: Cam, darbelere karşı dayanıklı hale getirmek için işlemden geçirilir.

meanings.en: to make or become less hard, firm, or stiff
meanings.exampleEn: Leave the butter out to soften before baking.
meanings.exampleTr: Pişirmeden önce tereyağını yumuşaması için dışarıda bırakın.

meanings.en: to make something less severe, harsh, or extreme
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to soften the bad news with a smile.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü haberi bir gülümsemeyle yumuşatmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: to treat someone with too much care or protection
meanings.exampleEn: His parents mollycoddle him and never let him take any risks.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesi ona aşırı düşkün davranıyor ve hiç risk almasına izin vermiyor.

meanings.en: an expert who is often asked to give an opinion in public or the media
meanings.exampleEn: Political pundits are predicting a close election.
meanings.exampleTr: Siyasi yorumcular çekişmeli bir seçim öngörüyor.

meanings.en: the quality of being the only one of its kind
meanings.exampleEn: The uniqueness of each snowflake fascinates scientists.
meanings.exampleTr: Her kar tanesinin benzersizliği bilim insanlarını büyülüyor.

meanings.en: too pleased with yourself and your achievements in an annoying way
meanings.exampleEn: He had a smug look on his face after winning the argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışmayı kazandıktan sonra yüzünde kendini beğenmiş bir ifade vardı.

meanings.en: feeling too satisfied with yourself and what you have done
meanings.exampleEn: Her self-satisfied smile irritated everyone in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendinden memnun gülümsemesi odadaki herkesi rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: carefully watching for possible danger or problems
meanings.exampleEn: Passengers should remain vigilant and report any suspicious behavior.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolcular tetikte olmalı ve şüpheli davranışları bildirmelidir.

meanings.en: the act of forcing someone to do something using threats or pressure
meanings.exampleEn: The confession was obtained through coercion and cannot be used in court.
meanings.exampleTr: İtiraf zorlama yoluyla alındı ve mahkemede kullanılamaz.

meanings.en: to change information into a digital form that computers can use
meanings.exampleEn: The library plans to digitize all its old manuscripts.
meanings.exampleTr: Kütüphane tüm eski el yazmalarını dijitalleştirmeyi planlıyor.

meanings.en: intended to calm someone or make them less angry, often by giving in to demands
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke in an appeasing tone to calm the angry customer.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeli müşteriyi sakinleştirmek için yatıştırıcı bir tonda konuştu.

meanings.en: intended to make someone stop feeling angry or upset
meanings.exampleEn: He made a placatory gesture and apologized for the mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatıştırıcı bir jest yaptı ve hata için özür diledi.

meanings.en: the activity of trying to end a conflict or bring about peace
meanings.exampleEn: The diplomat devoted his career to peacemaking in the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Diplomat kariyerini bölgede barış sağlamaya adadı.

meanings.tr: özlülük, veciz olma, kısa ve öz olma
meanings.en: the quality of expressing something clearly in few words
meanings.exampleEn: The report was praised for its succinctness and clarity.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor özlülüğü ve açıklığı nedeniyle övüldü.

meanings.en: the use of too many words to express an idea
meanings.exampleEn: The editor criticized the essay for its wordiness.
meanings.exampleTr: Editör, denemeyi laf kalabalığı nedeniyle eleştirdi.

meanings.en: a public statement in which someone is strongly criticized or accused
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper published a fierce denunciation of the government's policy.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete, hükümetin politikasına dair sert bir kınama yayımladı.

meanings.en: strong criticism or official disapproval
meanings.exampleEn: The senator faced censure for his controversial remarks.
meanings.exampleTr: Senatör, tartışmalı sözleri nedeniyle kınamayla karşılaştı.

meanings.en: to express strong disapproval of someone, especially officially
meanings.exampleEn: The committee voted to censure the official for misconduct.
meanings.exampleTr: Komite, görevliyi suistimal nedeniyle kınamak için oy kullandı.

meanings.en: without any conditions or limits
meanings.exampleEn: She loves her children unconditionally.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklarını koşulsuzca seviyor.

meanings.en: a woman you trust and share your private feelings or secrets with
meanings.exampleEn: Her sister has always been her closest confidante.
meanings.exampleTr: Kız kardeşi her zaman en yakın sırdaşı olmuştur.

meanings.en: to move away from an accepted course, standard, or plan
meanings.exampleEn: The pilot had to deviate from the planned route because of the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Pilot fırtına yüzünden planlanan rotadan sapmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to change from a liquid into a thick, solid mass
meanings.exampleEn: Blood begins to coagulate quickly when it leaves the body.
meanings.exampleTr: Kan, vücuttan çıktığında hızla pıhtılaşmaya başlar.

meanings.en: a person who defeats an opponent, especially in battle
meanings.exampleEn: The vanquisher was honored with a triumphant parade.
meanings.exampleTr: Galip, muzaffer bir geçit töreniyle onurlandırıldı.

meanings.en: involving or characterized by deep, quiet thought
meanings.exampleEn: He sat in a meditative silence, staring at the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Denize bakarak düşünceli bir sessizlik içinde oturdu.

meanings.en: interested only in your own group or country and not willing to accept different ideas
meanings.exampleEn: The town had an insular attitude toward outsiders.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasaba, yabancılara karşı dar görüşlü bir tutum sergiliyordu.

meanings.en: a lack of continuity or a break in something that should be continuous
meanings.exampleEn: There was a noticeable discontinuity between the two chapters of the book.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitabın iki bölümü arasında belirgin bir kopukluk vardı.

meanings.en: the feeling of being sorry for something wrong you have done
meanings.exampleEn: He showed genuine repentance for the harm he had caused.
meanings.exampleTr: Verdiği zarar için gerçek bir pişmanlık gösterdi.

meanings.en: the state of not being sorry for something wrong you have done
meanings.exampleEn: His impenitence shocked the judge, who had expected an apology.
meanings.exampleTr: Pişmanlık duymaması, özür bekleyen hakimi şaşırttı.

meanings.en: not managed, limited, or held back
meanings.exampleEn: Uncontrolled spending led the company into serious debt.
meanings.exampleTr: Kontrolsüz harcamalar şirketi ciddi borca soktu.

meanings.en: to stop a meeting or official process, usually to continue it later
meanings.exampleEn: The judge decided to adjourn the trial until Monday.
meanings.exampleTr: Hakim duruşmayı Pazartesiye ertelemeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: to meet or cross at a point (of lines, roads, or areas)
meanings.exampleEn: The two roads intersect near the town center.
meanings.exampleTr: İki yol şehir merkezinin yakınında kesişir.

meanings.en: a sudden, uncontrolled tightening of a muscle
meanings.exampleEn: A painful spasm shot through his back as he lifted the box.
meanings.exampleTr: Kutuyu kaldırırken sırtından acı verici bir kasılma geçti.

meanings.en: a meal or party where food is cooked outdoors over a fire; short for barbecue
meanings.exampleEn: We're having a BBQ in the garden this weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hafta sonu bahçede bir barbekü yapıyoruz.

meanings.en: a machine that makes copies of documents by photographing them
meanings.exampleEn: The photocopier is out of paper again.
meanings.exampleTr: Fotokopi makinesinin kağıdı yine bitmiş.

meanings.en: not having a physical body or form
meanings.exampleEn: The novel describes an incorporeal spirit haunting the old house.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, eski evde dolaşan cisimsiz bir ruhu anlatır.

meanings.tr: korsan gemisi kaptanı, resmi izinli korsan
meanings.en: a privately owned ship, or its captain, authorized by a government to attack enemy ships
meanings.exampleEn: The privateer was licensed by the crown to raid enemy vessels.
meanings.exampleTr: Korsan, düşman gemilerine baskın yapmak için kraliyet tarafından yetkilendirilmişti.

meanings.en: the group of people who travel with and assist an important person
meanings.exampleEn: The singer arrived with a large entourage of assistants and bodyguards.
meanings.exampleTr: Şarkıcı, kalabalık bir asistan ve koruma maiyetiyle geldi.

meanings.en: including or relating to people of many different cultures
meanings.exampleEn: London is a vibrant multicultural city.
meanings.exampleTr: Londra, canlı ve çokkültürlü bir şehirdir.

meanings.en: showing interest only in a narrow, limited range of matters, especially local ones
meanings.exampleEn: His parochial outlook made it hard for him to understand other cultures.
meanings.exampleTr: Dar görüşlü bakış açısı, başka kültürleri anlamasını zorlaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: the short form of 'could not', used to say something was not possible or allowed
meanings.exampleEn: I couldn't find my keys this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sabah anahtarlarımı bulamadım.

meanings.en: behaving in a pleasant, polite, and kind way
meanings.exampleEn: She was gracious enough to thank everyone who helped her.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendisine yardım eden herkese teşekkür edecek kadar nazikti.

meanings.en: in a kind, polite, and pleasant way
meanings.exampleEn: He graciously accepted the award and thanked his team.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü nazikçe kabul etti ve ekibine teşekkür etti.

meanings.en: a square open area surrounded by buildings, especially at a school or college
meanings.exampleEn: Students gathered in the quad between classes.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler dersler arasında avluda toplandı.

meanings.en: one of four children born at the same birth; short for quadruplet
meanings.exampleEn: She gave birth to healthy quads last spring.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen ilkbaharda sağlıklı dördüzler doğurdu.

meanings.en: to hide unpleasant facts or make something look better than it is
meanings.exampleEn: The company tried to whitewash the scandal in its annual report.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, skandalı yıllık raporunda örtbas etmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: to paint a wall or surface with a white liquid mixture
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to whitewash the old fence over the weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafta sonu eski çiti badanalamaya karar verdiler.

meanings.en: in a way that shows a strong desire for more food, money, or power than you need
meanings.exampleEn: The child ate the cake greedily, leaving nothing for the others.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk pastayı açgözlülükle yedi, diğerlerine hiçbir şey bırakmadı.

meanings.en: to make a sudden small movement because of fear, pain, or surprise
meanings.exampleEn: She didn't flinch when the doctor gave her the injection.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor iğneyi yaptığında hiç irkilmedi.

meanings.en: to avoid doing something unpleasant or difficult
meanings.exampleEn: He never flinches from telling the truth, however hard it is.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne kadar zor olursa olsun, gerçeği söylemekten hiç çekinmez.
